content.text:
All 16 tests pass now. Before the fix, 4 of 16 failed.

| Failure | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `test_unicode_folding` | Accented letters like `è` and `û` were replaced with `-` instead of becoming plain `e` and `u` (spec 1.1) | `slugify` now converts accented letters to their plain ASCII form and drops any other non-ASCII characters (`slugkit/slug.py:17-18`) |
| `test_punctuation_runs_collapse`, `test_custom_separator` | Each non-alphanumeric character became its own `sep`, so runs weren't collapsed into one (spec 1.2) | `slugify` now splits on runs of non-alphanumeric characters and joins the non-empty pieces with `sep`, which also removes leading and trailing separators (`slugkit/slug.py:19-20`) |
| `test_cuts_at_word_boundary` | An off-by-one: the separator search stopped one character short, so a `sep` sitting exactly at index `max_len` was missed (spec 2.2) | The search now goes up to `max_len + 1` (`slugkit/truncate.py:9`) |

```
$ python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .
Ran 16 tests in 0.001s
OK

$ git status --short
 M slugkit/slug.py
 M slugkit/truncate.py
```

I only changed files in `slugkit/`, which is the scope `.handoff/task.json` allows, and I left the tests untouched. Nothing is committed yet; tell me if you want a commit.
